answer: Because the willow history dates every edge, the lantern audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 11 epochs of prior interaction to count. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, because the pulse edge has to exist before the case does. A farm of 45 pays that 139 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
